summary: Having a high damage value breaks and crashes the game
description: /give @p minecraft:wolf_armor[minecraft:damage=2147483647] equip it on a wolf hit the wolf shear the armor off put it in an item frame /data get entity @e[type=minecraft:item_frame,sort=nearest,limit=1] if you try to save the game by going to the pause menu the game crashes
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Use the command `/give @p minecraft:wolf_armor[minecraft:damage=2147483647]` to obtain wolf armor with high damage value.
3. Equip the wolf armor on a wolf.
4. Hit the wolf to cause it to drop the armor.
5. Shear the wolf to remove any remaining armor pieces.
6. Pick up the dropped wolf armor and place it in an item frame.
7. Use the command `/data get entity @e[type=minecraft:item_frame,sort=nearest,limit=1]` to retrieve data from the nearest item frame.
8. Attempt to save the game by going to the pause menu (Esc menu -> Save and Quit to Title).
9. Observe that the game crashes when attempting to save.
Observed Behavior:
When a high damage value is assigned to wolf armor using commands, such as `/give @p minecraft:wolf_armor[minecraft:damage=2147483647]`, equipping the armor on a wolf and then shearing it off can lead to game instability. If the damaged wolf armor is placed in an item frame and its data is queried using `/data get entity @e[type=minecraft:item_frame,sort=nearest,limit=1]`, attempting to save the game by accessing the pause menu results in a crash.

This specific issue arises when manipulating the armor's damage value beyond normal limits, causing the game to encounter an unexpected state that ultimately leads to a crash upon saving. The sequence of actions—equipping, shearing, and placing the armor in an item frame—triggers this instability, making it difficult for the game to handle the high damage value correctly.
Expected Behavior: When following the steps to give a wolf high-damage wolf armor, equip it on a wolf, hit the wolf, shear off the armor, place it in an item frame, and attempt to save the game via the pause menu, the game should remain stable and not crash. The high damage value of the armor should not cause any unexpected behavior or instability, allowing players to interact with the armor normally without encountering crashes.
